summary: This note describes MCA Records, an American record label owned by MCA Inc. The label was later part of the larger MCA Music Entertainment Group, which became Universal Music Group. MCA Records was dissolved in 2003, while its country division, MCA Nashville, remains active as an imprint of Universal Music Group Nashville.
one_line: MCA Records was an American record label owned by MCA Inc. that was dissolved in 2003; its country division MCA Nashville is still active.
key_facts: MCA Records was an American record label owned by MCA Inc.
MCA Inc. later gave way to the larger MCA Music Entertainment Group.
MCA Music Entertainment Group is now Universal Music Group.
MCA Records was part of MCA Music Entertainment Group until its dissolution in 2003.
The label's country division is called MCA Nashville.
MCA Nashville is a still active imprint of Universal Music Group Nashville.
